name: openapi-docs
description: Scans a project's source code to discover its HTTP API surface — GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/HEAD/OPTIONS endpoints, path/query/header parameters, request/response body shapes, authorization requirements, and multipart file-upload endpoints — and generates an OpenAPI 3.0 spec plus a Swagger UI page, mounted on the app's own port by default so the API can be browsed and tried out with no separate server.
